in_pashto.name: شيره
in_pashto.meaning: د شيره نوم مطلب دى لوړه او عزت
in_pashto.long_meaning: شيره نوم د عربي جذر ش-ي-ر څخه اخيستل شوی دی او دى لوړه او عزت په پښتو کلتور کې دا نوم د پښتنو په دوديزو او مذهبي معنيو کې ځانګړی اهميت لري.

in_english.name: Shyraa
in_english.meaning: Shyraa means elevation, highness, and nobility
in_english.long_meaning: The name Shyraa is derived from the Arabic root ش-ی-ر (sh-y-r), which conveys meanings of elevation, highness, and nobility. In Islamic tradition, this name is significant for its beautiful and lofty connotations, reflecting positive attributes such as spiritual elevation and moral excellence. Historically, names with similar roots have been used to signify respect, honor, and high social status. In contemporary usage across Muslim cultures, Shyraa is valued for its rich etymological background and its association with virtuous qualities.
